WITH claimed AS (
            SELECT id
            FROM jobs
            WHERE queue = $1
              AND status = 'pending'
              AND run_at <= now()
            ORDER BY run_at
            LIMIT $2
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        )
        UPDATE jobs
        SET status = 'running',
            locked_until = $3,
            locked_by = $4,
            attempts = attempts + 1,
            updated_at = now()
        FROM claimed
        WHERE jobs.id = claimed.id
        RETURNING
            jobs.id,
            jobs.queue,
            jobs.kind,
            jobs.payload,
            jobs.attempts,
            jobs.max_attempts,
            jobs.run_at,
            jobs.locked_until,
            jobs.locked_by,
            jobs.status,
            jobs.last_error,
            jobs.created_at,
            jobs.updated_at
